metadata.source: Computed from astronomical positions for New Delhi (Lahiri ayanamsa), then corrected against Drik Panchang (New Delhi): main festivals for all months and every entry for May and August checked. Pradosh, Sankashti, Chandra Darshana, Anvadhan, Ishti and other minor days in the other months are unchecked.

tithi.source: Tithi at sunrise for New Delhi (Lahiri ayanamsa), North Indian (purnimanta) month names. Computed; checked against the Ekadashi, Purnima and Amavasya dates in this file.
